text:
marie: OK team, coinflip launch window opens in 15m. Quick run-through: pin check, canary warm, traffic gates, and rollback owners. I posted the tiny release notes: https://redwood.internal/rel/coinflip-1.2 :sparkles:
simon: confirming canary pool warmed, latency steady at 45-60ms for 90th percentile, no errors in last 30m :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CANARY_PIN: model-coinflip:v1.2 pinned by simon at 1876543235
marie: simon +1 on pin, alex do you have the smoke runbook ready?
alex: smoke runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/smoke/coinflip. Runs are scripted. Ran smoke locally earlier,-step results: auth ok, inference sanity ok, rates ok.
jamal: infra note: EU pool has a small scheduled maintenance at +3h — this rollout stays inside our 2h window so fine. but keeping watchers.
marie: rollback owners assigned: alex (primary), simon (secondary). If we hit error budget >2% over 5m, roll back to model-coinflip:v1.1.
ops-bot: TRAFFIC_GATE: hold CLOSED until explicit OPEN command. Metrics to watch: 5m error rate, 5m p50/p95 latency, embeddings cost spike.
luis: do we have a short blurb for customers if we need to roll back? I can prep a one-liner now.
marie: yes — "We've paused a new model rollout for stability; legacy behavior restored. No user data impacted." keep it high-level.
simon: smoke passes on canary group. Ready to open traffic gate when marie approves.
marie: ok opening 10% canary now. simon, run the `traffic-control open --percent 10 --tag coinflip-1.2` command when ready.
simon: running now:
```
traffic-control open --percent 10 --tag coinflip-1.2
# returned: success, gate state=OPEN, preview=10%
```
simon: gate open, metrics streaming. p95 at 62ms, error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.08%). Keeping watch.
jamal: watching infra metrics, no host restarts or OOMs.
marie: reminder: pin remains until we explicitly unpin after full rollout. if we need fast rollback: `deploy-bot rollback --to model-coinflip:v1.1 --force` (SREs have the key).
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK_READY: rollback target model-coinflip:v1.1 queued, requires confirmation from alex or simon.
alex: I see a small spike in tail latency, digging into KV cache warm pattern. If it doesn't settle in 3m, i'll request rollback.
luis: prepping customer note draft now, will ping #marketing for signoff if we roll back.
marie: cadence: wait 10m at 10% then 50% then 100% if stable. call out if error rate >0.5% or p95 >200ms.
simon: +1. i will escalate to full rollback if error >0.5% for 3 consecutive 5m buckets.
marie: thanks. keep messages short in this thread. ping me directly for immediate action. :rotating_light:
